prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: **17 countries in total** were covered at the initial 2018 rollout—five original markets plus 12 expansion markets. YouTube Music offered a free, ad-supported option alongside Premium, so none of those 17 were listed as paid-only.
